_comment: srt settings for the mytool MCP server, symlinked to ~/.config/srt/mytool.json by this recipe (outside every sandbox's allowWrite, so no confined process can rewrite it). The tightest useful shape, for a pure in-process transform: no network (empty allowedDomains), $HOME reads denied except the binaries dir, no writes. A server that writes temp files also needs /private/tmp and /private/var/folders in allowWrite, since srt-run points TMPDIR there. srt requires all four filesystem lists and both domain lists, even when empty. Add an allow only when a real denial breaks the server.
